walkthroughs.title: Get started with Nginx Config Atlas
walkthroughs.description: Open a sample nginx configuration, see its summary, syntax check and server blocks, and try the Pro security review and proxy review in the free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Open a sample file
steps.description:
Nginx Config Atlas reads nginx configuration files: nginx.conf, site files and included *.conf files. The sample is an invented configuration of a small web shop with a few typical problems, so every report has something to show. Open it to follow along, or open a configuration of your own.
[Open Sample File](command:nginxConfigAtlas.openSample)

steps.title: Run Show Summary
steps.description:
The file at a glance: directives, server blocks, locations, upstreams, the ports it listens on, its includes and the number of syntax problems. The report opens as a new Markdown document; your file is not changed.
[Show Summary](command:nginxConfigAtlas.showSummary)

steps.title: Use the other free reports
steps.description:
Every free report works without a key, an account or a network connection: Show Syntax Check, Show Server Blocks.
[Show Syntax Check](command:nginxConfigAtlas.showSyntax)
[Show Server Blocks](command:nginxConfigAtlas.showServers)

steps.title: Try Pro free for 14 days
steps.description:
The first Pro command you run starts a free 14-day trial on this computer, with no key and no network: Show Security Review, Show Proxy And Upstreams.
[Show Security Review](command:nginxConfigAtlas.showSecurity)

steps.title: Licence and help
steps.description:
Buy Pro (Personal USD 19, Business USD 39 per user), enter a key, see the licence status, or report a problem.
[Show Licence Status](command:nginxConfigAtlas.licenceStatus)
[Report A Problem](command:nginxConfigAtlas.reportProblem)

nginxConfigAtlas.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Largest file (in MB) a report reads, up to 50 MB (VS Code passes files only up to 50 MB to extensions). Larger files are refused with a message.

nginxConfigAtlas.openReportsAsPreview.markdownDescription: Open each report in the Markdown preview as well as in a new editor.
